evidence.title: Bitdeer July 2026 infrastructure update - Massillon
evidence.attribution: Bitdeer Technologies Group via SEC EDGAR
evidence.excerpt: The exhibit reports reconstruction of two fire-damaged Massillon buildings, scoped at 26 MW, currently under way.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of the exact 77261-byte SEC-hosted issuer Exhibit 99.1 response body
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from an all-rights-reserved issuer exhibit hosted by the SEC; raw bodies, headers, and publisher image are not redistributed.
metadata.visual_guardrail: The exhibit image is capture-lineage only. No imagery, computer vision, satellite, aerial, map-click, coordinate, or geometry claim is made.
metadata.physical_work_as_reported: Reconstruction of the two fire-damaged buildings (26 MW) is currently underway.
metadata.pipeline_capacity_scope: 26 MW is textually bound to the two reconstructed buildings and normalized once as planned project gross-facility capacity.
